Proposition
[Tangent Bundles of Manifolds with Boundary]

1. ch3:3.19If $M$ is a smooth manifold with boundary, its natural topology and smooth structure make $TM$ a smooth manifold with boundary. A boundary chart $(U,(x^i))$ on $M$ induces the boundary chart $(\pi ^{-1}(U),(v^i,x^i))$ by reordering the natural coordinates $(x^i,v^i)$.
